name: Vegas Orange TPU
filament_start_gcode:
; Orange Elastic TPU on Vegas (calibration suite v5, 2026-11-06): 240C (the box's 170-220C starves on this hotend), max 12 mm3/s, flow 102%, retract 0.2 (longer retractions starve the next part; stringing does not improve with length). Dry it first (55C, 8h). Bed 50 and exhaust 100%: at bed 70 the closed chamber softened the TPU above the hotend and it jammed (2026-11-07). Nothing slower than 15 mm/s: TPU that crawls through the hotend softens above the melt zone and jams (layer 62 internal bridge, 2026-11-07; 150% speed helped). Klipper owns PA and retraction
SET_PRESSURE_ADVANCE ADVANCE=0.12
SET_RETRACTION RETRACT_LENGTH=0.2 RETRACT_SPEED=30 UNRETRACT_SPEED=30
SET_FAN_SPEED FAN=exhaust_fan SPEED=1.0
